title: MWS — RECRUITMENT table
description: Array of Million Women Study baseline records. One element is one participant's baseline recruitment-questionnaire data, spanning three source sheets: Basic information, Recruitment variables, Self-reported health at recruit. Later-wave resurvey sheets are out of scope for this package.
$comment: This table has no participant-identifier field in the source dictionary at all (open item, see DECISIONS.md D007) -- uniqueItems is asserted as standing structural policy but cannot anchor to a real key here. Standard JSON Schema cannot enforce cross-row identifier uniqueness in any case; see the README's 'Documented but not enforced' section once written.

allOf.$comment: Skip pattern: never had children means number of full-term pregnancies, age at first/last birth, and the whole breastfeeding block are all structurally not applicable -- D041, steward-confirmed. This is the outer gate; RBFYN's own nested gate over RBFNUM/RBFDUR (below) still applies within the RANYCHLD=1 branch.

Applicability: a participant who has ever had children must have real values for RNUMFTP/RAGEFB/RAGELB/RBFYN, never the structural-NA code. RBFNUM/RBFDUR are deliberately excluded here -- their applicability is governed by the nested RBFYN=1 rule below, not directly by RANYCHLD (RANYCHLD=1 alone doesn't guarantee RBFYN=1) -- D041.
Skip pattern: not currently/never breastfed means breastfeeding count and duration are structurally not applicable -- D037, steward-confirmed.
Applicability: a participant who has ever breastfed must have a real value or an item-missing code for RBFNUM/RBFDUR, never the structural-NA code -- D037.

Skip pattern: never used oral contraceptives means start age, stop age, and duration are structurally not applicable -- D038, steward-confirmed (validated against the real questionnaire's own skip logic).
Applicability: a participant who has ever used oral contraceptives must have real values or item-missing codes for ROCSTART/ROCSTOP/ROCDUR, never the structural-NA code -- D038.
Skip pattern: never used HRT means start age, duration, last-used age, prior-periods-stopped flag, type, and time-since-last-used are all structurally not applicable -- D039, steward-confirmed.
Applicability: a participant who has ever used HRT (Past or Current) must have real values for start age, duration, prior-periods-stopped, and type, never the structural-NA code -- D039.

HRT routing: a participant currently using HRT has not stopped, so age-last-used and time-since-last-used are structurally not applicable -- D039, steward-confirmed via the real questionnaire wording ('are you using HRT? If no, how old were you when you last used it?').
Applicability: a participant who stopped using HRT in the past must have real values for age-last-used and time-since-last-used, never the structural-NA code -- D039.
Skip pattern: periods that have not stopped (or are irregular) mean age-periods-stopped is structurally not applicable -- D028, steward-confirmed.
Applicability: a participant whose periods have stopped must have a real age or an item-missing code for RPSTOPAG, never the structural-NA code -- D028.
Skip pattern: no hysterectomy means age at hysterectomy is structurally not applicable -- D030, inferred routing, pending steward confirmation.
Applicability: a participant who has had a hysterectomy must have a real age or an item-missing code for RHYSTAG, never the structural-NA code -- D030.

Skip pattern: no bilateral oophorectomy means age at oophorectomy is structurally not applicable -- D030, inferred routing, pending steward confirmation. Deliberately does NOT include ROOPH=3 (Not sure) -- whether that also forces not_applicable is an open question.
Applicability: a participant who has had a bilateral oophorectomy must have a real age or an item-missing code for ROOPHAGE, never the structural-NA code -- D030.
Skip pattern: not sterilised means age sterilised is structurally not applicable -- D030, inferred routing, pending steward confirmation.
Applicability: a participant who has been sterilised must have a real age or an item-missing code for RSTERAGE, never the structural-NA code -- D030.
